items.title: Marshall Lawrence Interview, 1960-06-28
items.q: I put him before DeJone, I said, that boy's going to be a drummer.

ctx.x: Lewis Matthews. That's his name? Yeah, that's Stonewall's brother. Yeah, you knew of him.

Yeah, well, Poissy and I were talking about that. Yeah, well, he played out here with us a good wife. Before you went to New Orleans? No, after you went to New Orleans. That's when I needed a trumpet player, you see, I was in trouble. Every time I trained a boy to play trumpet, they leave, then I had to begin to get men from this city. And the saxophone too. And Professor Holm played with us trumpet a good wife. From Russia, huh? From Russia. And, well, drums, we had several fellas play drums with us too. Our…
What kind of music do you like?
